title: Fixes, linked: a failing test joined to the run that passed it next and the commits between, accepted only by a person
request: Join a failing test run to the next passing run of the same test and the commits between, and propose a fix for a person to accept.
plan: Read the kept test runs in time order.
For each failing file, the next run of that file decides.
Keep each fix; a person's yes writes it beside the development records.

decisions.decision: A PostgreSQL failure is fixed only by a PostgreSQL pass.
decisions.why: The two backends fail differently; a file pass says nothing of the other.

change: dclab_rnd.store.fixes (link, accept, the fixes keeper), python -m dclab_rnd.store fixes|accept.

measurements.name: the fixes in this repository's test runs (2026-10-19 and 20)
measurements.gate: linked, never accepted without a person

outcome: Every test failure is linked to its fix, ready for the owner's yes.
lessons: The test runs kept whole were already the fixes' data; linking them cost no new capture.
risks: A fix proposed across many commits names them all; the cause is still a person's reading.
